definition: support w g n holds exactly when g = n + 1 and the target n has world w parity (false even, true odd). The same w must be retained along a local path. A local two-edge path is impossible because a successor has opposite parity. Edges have distinct endpoints and all endpoints exist in the model.
note: Task-local sense contrasted with the union certificate; forgetting labels is a mathematical operation, not cross-world causation.
